livekit_yaml:
# Exact TASK 4701 single-node release configuration.
# The signaling endpoint is reachable only through tls-front-door.py.
port: 17880
bind_addresses:
  - 127.0.0.1
rtc:
  tcp_port: 17881
  port_range_start: 17900
  port_range_end: 17999
  use_external_ip: false
  enable_loopback_candidate: true
  node_ip: 127.0.0.1
keys:
  OSLTask4701Key: OSLTask4701SecretAtLeast32BytesLong
room:
  auto_create: true
  max_participants: 3
logging:
  level: info
  json: true
